caseName: Aberdeen & Rockfish Railroad v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures
caseNameFull: Aberdeen & Rockfish Railroad Co. v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures (SCRAP) and Interstate Commerce Commission v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures (SCRAP)

opinions.text:
D. C. D. C. Application of SCRAP et al. to vacate stay entered by The Chief Justice on June 8, 1973, denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas would vacate the stay. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
